name: findyn
description: FinDyn v1.0 — S&P500 Dynamic State Engine. Root scripts orchestrate the dashboard build and the Worker deploy.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix dashboard install && npm --prefix serving install
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm --prefix serving run deploy
scripts.deploy:check: npm run build && npm --prefix serving run deploy:check
scripts.deploy:pages: npm run build && npx wrangler pages deploy dashboard/dist --project-name findyn-dashboard
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix serving run typecheck && npm --prefix dashboard run typecheck
